english.title: Unauthorised act in relation to a computer causing / creating risk of serious damage
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) did an unauthorised act in relation to a computer, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACT..),

(A)_[causing]_
(B)_[creating significant risk of]_

serious damage of a material kind, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DAMAGE..), having intended to cause such damage or being reckless as to whether such damage was caused and knowing, at the time of doing so, that the act was unauthorised
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3ZA(1) and (6) of the Computer Misuse Act 1990.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) If the act in question caused / created risk of serious damage to human welfare of a kind mentioned in section 3ZA(3)(a) or (3)(b), or damage to national security, offence document H12024 should be used.

(ii) Damage is of a material kind for the purposes of this section if it is -
(a) damage to human welfare in any place (see note (i));
(b) damage to the environment of any place;
(c) damage to the economy of any country; or
(d) damage to the national security of any country (see note (i))

(iii) It is immaterial whether or not an act causing damage does so directly and whether it is the only or main cause of the damage.

other.penalty:
